rule_or_requirement: A pixel-only faster controller must preserve valid completion before shorter laps count.
observable_information: Four grayscale frames, contiguous visible asphalt clearance at two near rows, road centers, obstacle pixels, rendered HUD speed, and the fixed stable actor action.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Raise the stable actor's gas to a fixed 0.20 floor only on clear, wide, non-approaching-bend road with small steer and no brake.
expected_success_endpoint: TRAIN action activation without a lost completion, followed by a four-direction fresh tune batch maintaining safety-control finish count and reducing median lap time.
control: Exact-hash selected full-road-guard actor on the same two consumed TRAIN cells.
falsifier: No gas-action change on either cell, invalid actions, or candidate failure where the control finishes.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Paired TRAIN 1/43 and 2/102, two arms, 2000 decisions per cell, full traces and risk-clear decision counts.
resource_and_risk_gate: Linux Python 3.11 CPU within 1800 seconds; no tune, held-out, confirmation, blind, package, or website action.
